reference_sql:
WITH window_pairs AS (  -- one row per pair of windows of one product that share at least one day
  SELECT a.product_id,
         a.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur,
         b.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur,
         b.valid_from AS shared_from,
         LEAST(COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')) AS shared_to
  FROM price_history AS a
  JOIN price_history AS b
    ON b.product_id = a.product_id
   AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
  WHERE b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT ol.order_line_id,
       ol.product_id,
       CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_date,
       w.old_price_eur,
       w.new_price_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN window_pairs AS w ON w.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN w.shared_from AND w.shared_to
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id

SELECT ol.order_line_id,
       ol.product_id,
       CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_date,
       a.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur,
       b.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
FROM price_history AS a
JOIN price_history AS b
  ON b.product_id = a.product_id
 AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
 AND b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.product_id = a.product_id
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) >= b.valid_from
  AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
  AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) <= COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id

WITH line_days AS (  -- one row per order line
  SELECT ol.order_line_id, ol.product_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS order_date
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
)
SELECT d.order_line_id,
       d.product_id,
       d.order_date,
       a.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur,
       b.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
FROM line_days AS d
JOIN price_history AS a
  ON a.product_id = d.product_id
 AND d.order_date BETWEEN a.valid_from AND COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
JOIN price_history AS b
  ON b.product_id = d.product_id
 AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
 AND d.order_date BETWEEN b.valid_from AND COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
ORDER BY d.order_line_id

solver.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT product_id, CAST(valid_from AS DATE) AS vf, CAST(valid_to AS DATE) AS vt, list_price_eur
  FROM price_history
),
p AS (
  SELECT a.product_id,
         b.vf AS shared_from,
         LEAST(COALESCE(a.vt, DATE '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(b.vt, DATE '9999-12-31')) AS shared_to,
         a.list_price_eur AS old_price_eur,
         b.list_price_eur AS new_price_eur
  FROM w a
  JOIN w b ON a.product_id = b.product_id
          AND a.vf < b.vf
          AND b.vf <= COALESCE(a.vt, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT ol.order_line_id, ol.product_id,
       CAST(CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS order_date,
       p.old_price_eur, p.new_price_eur
FROM p
JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE CAST(CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) BETWEEN p.shared_from AND p.shared_to
ORDER BY ol.order_line_id
